lessons.title: A New Job Offer
lessons.context: A short story about a difficult career decision.

paragraphs.de: Thomas arbeitet seit acht Jahren bei derselben Firma.
paragraphs.en: Thomas has worked at the same company for eight years.

paragraphs.de: Letzte Woche hat man ihm eine Stelle in einer anderen Stadt mit besserem Gehalt angeboten.
paragraphs.en: Last week they offered him a position in another city, with a better salary.

paragraphs.de: Er ist sich nicht sicher, ob es eine gute Idee ist, seine Freunde und seine Routine zu verlassen.
paragraphs.en: He's not sure it's a good idea to leave his friends and his routine.

paragraphs.de: Seine Frau hat ihm gesagt, dass er an seine Zukunft denken muss, nicht nur an die Gegenwart.
paragraphs.en: His wife told him he needed to think about his future, not just the present.

paragraphs.de: Er hat sich noch nicht entschieden, aber er muss vor Freitag antworten.
paragraphs.en: He still hasn't decided what to do, but he has to respond by Friday.

questions.question: How long has Thomas worked at his company?
What did they offer him last week?
options: A promotion at the same office

questions.question: Why is Thomas unsure?
options: He would have to leave his friends and routine
He doesn't like the new city

questions.question: By when does he need to respond?

lessons.title: The Neighborhood That Changed
lessons.titleNative: Das Viertel, das sich verändert hat
lessons.context: A reflective story using the Perfekt tense to describe change.

paragraphs.de: Als Julia in ihr altes Viertel zurückkam, hat sie es kaum wiedererkannt.
paragraphs.en: When Julia returned to her old neighborhood, she almost didn't recognize it.

paragraphs.de: Sie haben mehrere neue Gebäude gebaut, wo früher kleine Häuser standen.
paragraphs.en: They had built several new buildings where there used to be small houses.

paragraphs.de: Der Laden, in dem sie als Kind Süßigkeiten kaufte, ist schon vor Jahren geschlossen.
paragraphs.en: The store where she used to buy candy as a child had already closed years ago.

paragraphs.de: Der Park aber, in dem sie gespielt hat, ist genau gleich geblieben.
paragraphs.en: However, the park where she used to play was still exactly the same.

paragraphs.de: Sie hat sich auf eine Bank gesetzt und sich an alles erinnert, was sie dort erlebt hat.
paragraphs.en: She sat on a bench and remembered everything she had experienced there.

questions.question: What happened when Julia returned to her neighborhood?
What had they built?
What had already closed?
options: The store where she bought candy

questions.question: What stayed the same?
options: The park where she used to play

lessons.title: My First Job
lessons.context: A short story about a first work experience, told in the past tense.

paragraphs.de: Mein erster Job war in einem kleinen Café im Stadtzentrum.
paragraphs.en: My first job was at a small café downtown.

paragraphs.de: Ich habe am Wochenende gearbeitet, während ich an der Universität studiert habe.
paragraphs.en: I worked on weekends while I studied at university.

paragraphs.de: Am Anfang wusste ich nicht, wie man Kaffee macht, aber ich habe schnell gelernt.
paragraphs.en: At first I didn't know how to make coffee, but I learned quickly.

paragraphs.de: Mein Chef war sehr geduldig und hat mir immer alles ruhig erklärt.
paragraphs.en: My boss was very patient and always explained everything to me calmly.

paragraphs.de: Dieser Job hat mir beigebracht, verantwortungsbewusst zu sein und mit Menschen zu sprechen.
paragraphs.en: That job taught me to be responsible and to talk with people.

questions.question: Where was the writer's first job?
When did they work there?
What did the writer not know how to do at first?
What did this job teach the writer?
options: To be responsible and talk with people

lessons.title: A Rainy Day at Home
lessons.context: A short story about spending a rainy day indoors.

paragraphs.de: Gestern hat es den ganzen Tag geregnet, also sind wir zu Hause geblieben.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday it rained all day, so we stayed home.

paragraphs.de: Wir haben heißen Kakao gemacht und zusammen einen Film gesehen.
paragraphs.en: We made hot chocolate and watched a movie together.

paragraphs.de: Die Kinder haben den ganzen Nachmittag Brettspiele gespielt.
paragraphs.en: The children played board games all afternoon.

paragraphs.de: Obwohl wir nicht rausgegangen sind, war es ein sehr schöner Tag.
paragraphs.en: Although we didn't go out, it was a very nice day.

paragraphs.de: Manchmal ändern sich die Pläne, aber das bedeutet nicht, dass der Tag schlecht wird.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes plans change, but that doesn't mean the day is bad.

questions.question: What was the weather like yesterday?
What did they make?
What did the children do?
What does the passage say about changing plans?
options: It doesn't mean the day is bad

lessons.title: Planning a Birthday Party
lessons.context: A short story about organizing a celebration.

paragraphs.de: Nächsten Monat hat meine Mutter Geburtstag, und wir planen eine Feier.
paragraphs.en: Next month is my mother's birthday, and we are planning a party.

paragraphs.de: Meine Geschwister und ich schmücken das Haus mit Luftballons und Blumen.
paragraphs.en: My siblings and I are decorating the house with balloons and flowers.

paragraphs.de: Wir bereiten ihr Lieblingsessen und einen Schokoladenkuchen vor.
paragraphs.en: We are preparing her favorite dish and a chocolate cake.

paragraphs.de: Wir haben die ganze Familie und ihre besten Freundinnen eingeladen.
paragraphs.en: We invited the whole family and her closest friends.

paragraphs.de: Wir wollen, dass sie sich an diesem Tag ganz besonders fühlt.
paragraphs.en: We want her to feel very special on that day.

questions.question: Whose birthday is coming up?
What are they decorating the house with?
What are they preparing?
options: Her favorite dish and a chocolate cake

questions.question: Who did they invite?
options: The whole family and her closest friends

lessons.title: A Memorable Trip
lessons.context: A short past-tense narrative about a family trip.

paragraphs.de: Letztes Jahr sind wir zum ersten Mal als Familie an die Küste gefahren.
paragraphs.en: Last year we traveled to the coast for the first time as a family.

paragraphs.de: Wir sind in einem kleinen Hotel in der Nähe des Strandes geblieben.
paragraphs.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.

paragraphs.de: Jeden Tag sind wir vor dem Frühstück am Strand spazieren gegangen.
paragraphs.en: Every day we walked on the beach before breakfast.

paragraphs.de: Eines Tages haben wir Delfine gesehen, die ganz nah am Ufer geschwommen sind.
paragraphs.en: One day we saw dolphins swimming very close to the shore.

paragraphs.de: Es war eine Reise, die wir nie vergessen werden.
paragraphs.en: It was a trip we are never going to forget.

questions.question: Where did the family travel to last year?
Where did they stay?
options: A small hotel near the beach

questions.question: What did they do every day?
options: Walked on the beach before breakfast

questions.question: What did they see one day?

lessons.title: Learning to Cook
lessons.context: A short story about learning a new skill.

paragraphs.de: Vor zwei Jahren konnte ich fast gar nicht kochen.
paragraphs.en: Two years ago I hardly knew how to cook anything.

paragraphs.de: Meine Oma hat mir geduldig ihre Lieblingsrezepte beigebracht.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother patiently taught me her favorite recipes.

paragraphs.de: Am Anfang habe ich viele Fehler gemacht, aber ich habe weiter geübt.
paragraphs.en: At first I made a lot of mistakes, but I kept practicing.

paragraphs.de: Jetzt kann ich mehrere Gerichte kochen, die meiner ganzen Familie schmecken.
paragraphs.en: Now I can prepare several dishes that my whole family likes.

paragraphs.de: Kochen ist eine meiner Lieblingsaktivitäten geworden.
paragraphs.en: Cooking became one of my favorite activities.

questions.question: How much did the writer know about cooking two years ago?
Who taught the writer to cook?
What did the writer do despite making mistakes?
What did cooking become for the writer?

lessons.title: A Health Scare
lessons.context: A short story about a minor illness and recovery.

paragraphs.de: Letzte Woche habe ich mich nicht gut gefühlt und hatte hohes Fieber.
paragraphs.en: Last week I didn't feel well and had a high fever.

paragraphs.de: Ich bin zum Arzt gegangen, und er hat gesagt, es sei nur eine starke Grippe.
paragraphs.en: I went to the doctor, and he told me it was just a strong flu.

paragraphs.de: Er hat mir Medikamente verschrieben und gesagt, ich soll mich ausruhen.
paragraphs.en: He prescribed me medications and told me to rest.

paragraphs.de: Meine Familie hat sich jeden Tag um mich gekümmert, bis es mir besser ging.
paragraphs.en: My family took care of me every day until I got better.

paragraphs.de: Nach einer Woche habe ich mich schon wieder wie neu gefühlt.
paragraphs.en: After a week, I already felt like new again.

questions.question: How did the writer feel last week?
options: Not well, with a high fever

questions.question: What did the doctor say it was?
What did the doctor recommend?
Who took care of the writer?

lessons.title: A Lesson from My Grandfather
lessons.context: A short reflective story about wisdom passed down.

paragraphs.de: Als ich klein war, habe ich viele Nachmittage mit meinem Großvater in seinem Garten verbracht.
paragraphs.en: When I was little, I spent many afternoons with my grandfather in his garden.

paragraphs.de: Er hat mir viel über Pflanzen erzählt, aber auch über das Leben.
paragraphs.en: He told me a lot about plants, but also about life.

paragraphs.de: Er hat immer gesagt, dass Geduld der Schlüssel zu allem ist.
paragraphs.en: He always said that patience is the key to everything.

paragraphs.de: Jetzt, wo ich erwachsen bin, verstehe ich seine Worte besser.
paragraphs.en: Now that I am an adult, I understand his words better.

paragraphs.de: Ich denke immer noch an ihn, wenn ich in meinem eigenen Garten arbeite.
paragraphs.en: I still think of him when I work in my own garden.

questions.question: Where did the writer spend time with their grandfather?
What did the grandfather talk about besides plants?
What did the grandfather say was the key to everything?
What does the writer do now?

lessons.title: A New Beginning
lessons.context: A capstone story reflecting on change and growth.

paragraphs.de: Vor einem Jahr habe ich beschlossen, meinen Job zu wechseln und in eine andere Stadt zu ziehen.
paragraphs.en: A year ago I decided to change jobs and move to another city.

paragraphs.de: Am Anfang hatte ich Angst, weil ich niemanden dort kannte.
paragraphs.en: At first I was afraid because I didn't know anyone there.

paragraphs.de: Nach und nach habe ich neue Freunde gefunden und die Stadt kennengelernt.
paragraphs.en: Little by little I made new friends and got to know the city.

paragraphs.de: Jetzt fühle ich mich zu Hause und bin sehr glücklich mit meiner Entscheidung.
paragraphs.en: Now I feel at home and I am very happy with my decision.

paragraphs.de: Ich habe gelernt, dass manchmal die schwierigsten Veränderungen die besten Überraschungen bringen.
paragraphs.en: I learned that sometimes the most difficult changes bring the best surprises.

questions.question: What did the writer decide to do a year ago?
options: Change jobs and move to another city

questions.question: Why was the writer afraid at first?
What happened little by little?
What did the writer learn?
options: Difficult changes can bring the best surprises
